method: The 960px and wide values are rendered measurements from #94: document.querySelector('.top').offsetHeight in Chromium, over the 46 + 28 renders recorded there (locale and default-font-size variants), tallest per breakpoint. The phone value is not a rendered maximum: #133 gives the header a fixed height below 641px, a 64px row plus the 1px bottom border of .top, so no locale, label or default font size can grow it. The rendered confirmation at 360/390/430 in both locales is the phone matrix #133 asks Test to run at the tip.
